deadline.value: The deadline for funded 2027/28 PhD positions is 15 January 2027; applications may be considered after that on a rolling basis if funding remains.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for these positions is 15 January 2027.

gre_subject.value: King's does not consider the GRE in its selection processes, so no GRE Subject test is used.
gre_subject.quote: Please note that at King's we do not consider the GRE in our selection processes.

supervisor.value: Written agreement from a supervisor is needed before the application can go forward; the department also asks applicants to contact the supervisor first.
supervisor.quote: You must receive written confirmation that your supervisor(s) have agreed to submit you before progressing with your application.

also.quote: Prior to application, the applicant should contact the potential supervisor to discuss the applicant's suitability for the proposed project.

funding.value: All scholarships and awards are competitive; the department notes high competition for funded studentships.
funding.quote: All scholarships, bursaries or other awards are offered on a competitive basis.

entry_route.value: An undergraduate degree or an MSc in Computer Science or a relevant discipline is accepted.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have an undergraduate degree or MSc in Computer Science or another discipline relevant for their PhD project

notes: Funded places are for 2027/28. The page also names EPSRC Doctoral Landscape Award and Centre for Doctoral Training funding. No separate AI or data science PhD is listed.
